BETWEEN:-
 BHIMSEN PANIKA S/O VANSHGOPAL PANIKA, AGED  ABOUT 24 YEARS, OCCUPATION:
LABOUR R/O VILLAGE  BHATHA POLICE STATION JAMODI DISTT.

SIDHI  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI P. K. VERMA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION JAMODI DISTRICT SIDHI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI C. K. MISHRA - GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 o f the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.595/2023, dated 21.7.2023, registered at Police Station Jamodi,
District Sidhi (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 304B, 498A of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant - Bhimsen Panika is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
However, as prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, applicant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for bail after evidence of parents and brother of the deceased.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Bhimsen Panika vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85200292/
